scenario.name: ramp-cpu
scenario.description: Task 2.5 (a), the CPU baseline: rated capacity of the containerized pipeline (ingest, one yolo11n worker on the PyTorch CPU backend at batch size 1, Postgres, object store) on the data-mini clips at 5 FPS per camera, 1280x720 q85. Steps 1, 2, 3, 4 cameras: model-only yolo11n does about 10 to 20 frames/s on this laptop (E-014, E-016) and one saturated worker did 8 to 12 end to end (E-026), so the edge is expected between 1 and 4 cameras and the powers of two the plan suggests would step over it. No query load (that is query-load-cpu). Hold 90 s after 20 s warmup, so a backlog growing by 0.5 frames/s (the steady-state limit) shows up as 45 frames over the window. Run on a quiet host: nothing else CPU-heavy (E-027).
